title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・リグレット

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide runs her best race ever… but it still isn't enough to win the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If the venue for the race hadn't been changed, Biwa Hayahide could've maximized the results of her equation and maybe even won…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide wants to be the greatest of her generation and eventually defeat Narita Brian, so she isn't satisfied with her current performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why our next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen, where only the best are chosen to race. We begin working hard, so Biwa Hayahide can improve even more.
